effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.

reader.label: Sublinear exponent in expression width
reader.title: Edge Dominating Set by intrinsic clique-width under ETH

sourceBasis.step: The source theorem excludes the graph-order clock even when an expression of bounded width is available. An intrinsic-clock algorithm would also accept those graphs, as intrinsic clique-width is at most the supplied width. A nondecreasing majorant of a sublinear exponent remains sublinear.

statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm solves Edge Dominating Set, measured by intrinsic clique-width, within the stated running time.
